critical_code_review_comments: trash.py archive_entity strips top-level _id but children docs come from `_db[key].find(..., {'_id': 0})` before being passed in — good, no ObjectId leakage.
GET /trash pipeline correctly projects size of children arrays and excludes heavy data payload.
restore_trash returns 409 on entity_id collision — correct.
delete_job archives children as one entry then hard-deletes them — atomicity is best-effort (no txn); acceptable for single-user offline app.
JobsList.jsx delete icon button previously lacked data-testid — added `job-delete-btn-<jobId>` and testids on the confirm/cancel actions (job-delete-confirm-btn / job-delete-cancel-btn).
